annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act bars any law enforcement agency (a state or local public agency responsible for crime prevention and detection and enforcement of laws) from using a drone to gather evidence or other information.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: no law enforcement agency shall use a drone to gather evidence or other information.
annotation.dates_quote: SECTION 2. This act shall take effect July 1, 2013, the public welfare requiring it.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This section shall be known and may be cited as the "Freedom from Unwarranted Surveillance Act".
